description: This file implements a driver interface for a radio transceiver, including session management, buffer handling, gain control, and event notification, specifically for the 'trx_ocudu' module within a software radio system.

classes.name: radio_notification_handler_impl
classes.description: Implements radio event notification handling, tracking underflow and overflow counts.

classes.name: baseband_gateway_buffer_trx
classes.description: Manages buffers for transmitting and receiving complex baseband samples, including conversion between floating point and integer formats.

classes.name: baseband_gateway_buffer_zeros
classes.description: Provides a buffer filled with zeros for baseband data, used for padding or silence.

classes.name: trx_ocudu_session_context
classes.description: Holds parameters and state for a trx_ocudu session, including configuration, buffers, and session management objects.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_write2
methods.description: Handles writing samples to the radio, including padding, noise addition, and metadata handling.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_read2
methods.description: Handles reading samples from the radio, retrieving data from buffers and metadata.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_set_tx_gain
methods.description: Sets the transmit gain for a specific chain.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_set_rx_gain
methods.description: Sets the receive gain for a specific chain.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_start
methods.description: Initializes and starts a radio session with specified parameters.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_end
methods.description: Stops and cleans up a radio session.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_get_sample_rate
methods.description: Retrieves the sample rate for the session.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_get_tx_samples_per_packet
methods.description: Returns the number of samples per packet for transmission.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_get_stats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics such as underflow and overflow counts.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_get_tx_gain
methods.description: Gets the current transmit gain for a channel.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_get_rx_gain
methods.description: Gets the current receive gain for a channel.

methods.name: trx_ocudu_dump_info
methods.description: Outputs information about the current driver configuration.

methods.name: trx_driver_init
methods.description: Initializes the trx_ocudu driver, setting up session context and configuration based on parameters.
